moments.title: Summer Bank Holiday Weekend
moments.blurb: The last UK Bank Holiday of the summer for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland falls on Monday, August 31st, marking the unofficial end of the season for many.

angles.name: Long Weekend Vibes
angles.copy: That glorious feeling when you know the Summer Bank Holiday weekend is just around the corner. Who's making the most of these last days of August?

angles.name: End of Summer
angles.copy: The final summer Bank Holiday for many in the UK arrives on Monday. How are you waving goodbye to August?

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festivals Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The iconic Reading and Leeds Festivals take over Richfield Avenue and Bramham Park from August 27-30, featuring headliners like Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, Fontaines D.C., Chase & Status Live, and Raye.

angles.name: Festival Fever
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds is almost here! Who are you most excited to catch this weekend? Charli XCX, Florence + The Machine, Dave, Fontaines D.C. – the lineup is huge!

angles.name: Bank Holiday Beats
angles.copy: Your Bank Holiday weekend soundtrack is sorted! Reading & Leeds kicks off Thursday, bringing the best in rock, pop, hip-hop, and dance. Let's go!

moments.title: Creamfields 2026 Begins
moments.blurb: Creamfields, one of the UK's biggest electronic music festivals, runs from August 27-29 in Cheshire, with headliners including Calvin Harris, Underworld, and Sonny Fodera.

angles.name: Dance Nation
angles.copy: The fields are calling! Creamfields is almost here, bringing Calvin Harris, Underworld, and more to Cheshire this Bank Holiday weekend. Who's ready to rave?

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Three days of non-stop dance anthems are about to drop! Creamfields 2026 kicks off Thursday. Get your glow sticks ready!

moments.title: All Points East Continues in London
moments.blurb: All Points East festival continues in Victoria Park, London, until August 30th, featuring major acts like Tyler, the Creator, Lorde, Deftones, and Twenty One Pilots.

angles.name: London Calling
angles.copy: All Points East is still bringing the heat to Victoria Park! Who's catching Tyler, the Creator, Lorde, or Deftones before the festival wraps up?

angles.name: East London Vibes
angles.copy: London's summer festival season is peaking with All Points East. If you're heading down this week, what's your must-see act?

moments.title: Between The Trees Festival, South Wales
moments.blurb: The immersive music, art, and nature festival, Between The Trees, returns to South Wales from August 27-30, offering a unique woodland experience.

angles.name: Welsh Festival Fun
angles.copy: South Wales is getting ready for Between The Trees Festival! Music, art, and nature combine for a unique experience this Bank Holiday weekend. Who's in?

angles.name: Local Wales Vibes
angles.copy: Looking for something different this Bank Holiday? Between The Trees Festival in South Wales offers an amazing blend of creativity and the great outdoors.

moments.title: Bon Jovi's 'Forever Tour' Hits UK
moments.blurb: Bon Jovi's highly anticipated 'Forever Tour' arrives in the UK this week, with shows in Edinburgh (starting Aug 28) and London (starting Sep 4), marking their first UK performances in seven years.

angles.name: It's My Life
angles.copy: Bon Jovi are back in the UK! Their 'Forever Tour' kicks off in Edinburgh this week. Who's got tickets to see the legends live for the first time in seven years?

angles.name: Rock Icons Return
angles.copy: Seven years is too long! Bon Jovi are bringing their anthems to Edinburgh this week and London next. Get ready for some classic rock!

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean Hold UK No.1
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' remains at No.1 on the Official UK Singles Chart for an incredible 22nd week, as new entries from Madonna & Kylie Minogue make waves.

angles.name: Chart Domination
angles.copy: Still unstoppable! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is UK No.1 for a staggering 22nd week. Can anyone knock them off?

angles.name: New Chart Entries
angles.copy: While 'Rein Me In' reigns, Madonna & Kylie Minogue's 'Love Sensation' is a big new entry on the Official Singles Chart! What's your favourite new tune?

moments.title: Happy 77th Birthday, Gene Simmons
moments.blurb: Today, August 25th, marks the 77th birthday of KISS co-founder, bassist, and co-lead vocalist, the iconic Gene Simmons.

angles.name: The Demon Turns 77
angles.copy: Shout out to the one and only Demon! Happy 77th Birthday to KISS legend Gene Simmons. What's your favourite KISS track?

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Raise a glass! Gene Simmons of KISS is 77 today. Still rocking harder than most.

moments.title: Happy 72nd Birthday, Elvis Costello

angles.name: New Wave Legend
angles.copy: Happy 72nd Birthday to the brilliant Elvis Costello! From 'Pump It Up' to 'Alison', what's the track that defines him for you?

angles.name: Birthday Tunes
angles.copy: Celebrating 72 years of lyrical genius! Happy Birthday to the incredible Elvis Costello.

angles.copy: Celebrating a true pioneer of electronic music! Happy 63rd to Paul Oakenfold this weekend.

angles.copy: Celebrating a living legend! Happy 45th Birthday to the incomparable Beyoncé this Friday.

moments.title: Ted Lasso Season 4 Continues
moments.blurb: The fourth season of the beloved comedy-drama 'Ted Lasso' continues with new episodes weekly on Apple TV+, following Ted coaching a second division women's football team.

angles.name: Believe in Ted
angles.copy: Still believing! New episodes of Ted Lasso Season 4 are dropping weekly on Apple TV+. Are you enjoying the new direction for AFC Richmond?

angles.name: Football & Feel-Good
angles.copy: Ted Lasso's back and coaching a women's team this season! If you're looking for your weekly dose of feel-good football, catch Season 4 on Apple TV+.

moments.title: This City is Ours Season 2 on BBC One
moments.blurb: The second season of the crime drama 'This City is Ours', set in Liverpool, continues airing on BBC One throughout August.

angles.name: Liverpool Crime Drama
